Time for Vader to face his past.|Back cover blurb|''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''}} '''''Thrawn: Alliances''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]] published by [[Del Rey]] on [[July 24]], [[2018]] as the sequel to the [[2017]] novel [[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']], as well as the second book in ''[[Star Wars: The Imperial Trilogy]]''. The story features [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] on a mission shortly after the events of [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Three]], while a parallel narrative set during the [[Clone Wars]] features Thrawn, Anakin Skywalker, and [[Padmé Amidala]]. Chronologically, ''Thrawn: Alliances'' is set between the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third]] and [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth]] seasons of the animated television show ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. It was also released as an [[Thrawn: Alliances (audiobook)|audiobook]], narrated by [[Marc Thompson]]. In [[2024]], [[Marvel Comics]] published a four-issue [[Star Wars: Thrawn: Alliances (comic series)|''Star Wars: Thrawn: Alliances'' comic adaptation]] of the novel, written by Zahn and [[Jody Houser]]. The final instalment of the trilogy, ''[[Thrawn: Treason]]'', was released in [[2019]].
